1.english_reference: Now it came to pass , as David sat in his house ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֕י כַּ אֲשֶׁ֛ר יָשַׁ֥ב דָּוִ֖יד בְּ בֵית֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς κατῴκησεν Δαυεὶδ ἐν οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Cum autem habitáret David in domo sua ,
traditions.KJV: Now it came to pass , as David sat in his house ,

1.english_reference: that David said to Nathan the prophet ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜יד אֶל נָתָ֣ן הַ נָּבִ֗יא
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυεὶδ πρὸς Ναθὰν τὸν προφήτην
traditions.VUL: dixit ad Nathan prophétam :
traditions.KJV: that David said to Nathan the prophet ,

1.english_reference: Lo , I dwell in an house of cedars ,

traditions.WLC: הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֤י יוֹשֵׁב֙ בְּ בֵ֣ית הָֽ אֲרָזִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: Ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ κατοικῶ ἐν οἴκῳ κεδρίνῳ ,
traditions.VUL: Ecce ego hábito in domo cédrina :
traditions.KJV: Lo , I dwell in an house of cedars ,

1.english_reference: but the ark of the covenant of the LORD [ remaineth ] under curtains .

traditions.WLC: וַ אֲר֥וֹן בְּרִית יְהוָ֖ה תַּ֥חַת יְרִיעֽוֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἡ κιβωτὸς διαθήκης Κυρίου ὑποκάτω δέρρεων .
traditions.VUL: arca autem fœ́deris Dómini sub péllibus est .
traditions.KJV: but the ark of the covenant of the LORD [ remaineth ] under curtains .

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֤אמֶר נָתָן֙ אֶל דָּוִ֔יד
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Ναθὰν πρὸς Δαυείδ
traditions.VUL: Et ait Nathan ad David :
traditions.KJV: Then Nathan said unto David ,

2.english_reference: Do all that [ is ] in thine heart ;

traditions.WLC: כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּֽ לְבָבְ ךָ֖ עֲשֵׂ֑ה
traditions.LXX: Πᾶν τὸ ἐν ψυχῇ σου ποίει ,
traditions.VUL: Omnia , quæ in corde tuo sunt , fac :
traditions.KJV: Do all that [ is ] in thine heart ;

traditions.WLC: כִּ֥י הָ אֱלֹהִ֖ים עִמָּֽ ךְ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι θεὸς μετὰ σοῦ .
traditions.VUL: Deus enim tecum est .
traditions.KJV: for God [ is ] with thee .

3.english_reference: And it came to pass the same night ,

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יְהִ֖י בַּ לַּ֣יְלָה הַ ה֑וּא
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῇ νυκτὶ ἐκείνῃ
traditions.VUL: Igitur nocte illa
traditions.KJV: And it came to pass the same night ,

3.english_reference: that the word of God came to Nathan , saying ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִי֙ דְּבַר אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶל נָתָ֖ן לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος Κυρίου πρὸς Ναθάν .
traditions.VUL: factus est sermo Dei ad Nathan , dicens :
traditions.KJV: that the word of God came to Nathan , saying ,

4.english_reference: Go and tell David my servant ,

traditions.WLC: לֵ֤ךְ וְ אָמַרְתָּ֙ אֶל דָּוִ֣יד עַבְדִּ֔ י
traditions.LXX: Πορεύου καὶ εἰπὸν πρὸς Δαυεὶδ τὸν δοῦλόν μου
traditions.VUL: Vade , et lóquere David servo meo :
traditions.KJV: Go and tell David my servant ,

traditions.WLC: כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: Οὕτως εἶπεν Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Hæc dicit Dóminus :
traditions.KJV: Thus saith the LORD ,

4.english_reference: Thou shalt not build me an house to dwell in :

traditions.WLC: לֹ֥א אַתָּ֛ה תִּבְנֶה לִּ֥ י הַ בַּ֖יִת לָ שָֽׁבֶת
traditions.LXX: Οὐ σὺ οἰκοδομήσεις οἶκον τοῦ κατοικῆσαί με ἐν αὐτῷ .
traditions.VUL: Non ædificábis tu mihi domum ad habitándum .
traditions.KJV: Thou shalt not build me an house to dwell in :

5.english_reference: For I have not dwelt in an house

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָשַׁ֨בְתִּי֙ בְּ בַ֔יִת
traditions.LXX: ὅτι οὐ κατῴκησα ἐν οἴκῳ
traditions.VUL: Neque enim mansi in domo
traditions.KJV: For I have not dwelt in an house

5.english_reference: since the day that I brought up Israel unto this day ;

traditions.WLC: מִן הַ יּ֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֶעֱלֵ֨יתִי֙ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֖ד הַ יּ֣וֹם הַ זֶּ֑ה
traditions.LXX: ἀπὸ τῆς ἡμέρας ἧς ἀνήγαγον τὸν Ἰσραὴλ ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης ,
traditions.VUL: ex eo témpore , quo edúxi Israel usque ad diem hanc :
traditions.KJV: since the day that I brought up Israel unto this day ;

5.english_reference: but have gone from tent to tent , and from [ one ] tabernacle [ to another ] .

traditions.WLC: וָֽ אֶהְיֶ֛ה מֵ אֹ֥הֶל אֶל אֹ֖הֶל וּ מִ מִּשְׁכָּֽן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἤμην ἐν σκηνῇ καὶ ἐν καλύμματι .
traditions.VUL: sed fui semper mutans loca tabernáculi , et in tentório
traditions.KJV: but have gone from tent to tent , and from [ one ] tabernacle [ to another ] .

6.english_reference: Wheresoever I have walked with all Israel ,

traditions.WLC: בְּ כֹ֥ל אֲשֶֽׁר הִתְהַלַּכְתִּי֮ בְּ כָל יִשְׂרָאֵל֒
traditions.LXX: ἐν πᾶσιν οἷς διῆλθον ἐν παντὶ Ἰσραήλ ·
traditions.VUL: manens cum omni Israel .
traditions.KJV: Wheresoever I have walked with all Israel ,

6.english_reference: spake I a word to any of the judges of Israel ,

traditions.WLC: הֲ דָבָ֣ר דִּבַּ֗רְתִּי אֶת אַחַד֙ שֹׁפְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
traditions.LXX: εἰ λαλῶν ἐλάλησα πρὸς μίαν φυλὴν τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ
traditions.VUL: Numquid locútus sum saltem uni iúdicum Israel ,
traditions.KJV: spake I a word to any of the judges of Israel ,

6.english_reference: whom I commanded to feed my people ,

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֛יתִי לִ רְע֥וֹת אֶת עַמִּ֖ י
traditions.LXX: τοῦ ποιμαίνειν τὸν λαόν μου
traditions.VUL: quibus præcéperam ut páscerent pópulum meum ,
traditions.KJV: whom I commanded to feed my people ,

6.english_reference: saying , Why have ye not built me an house of cedars ?

traditions.WLC: לֵ אמֹ֑ר לָ֛ מָּה לֹא בְנִיתֶ֥ם לִ֖ י בֵּ֥ית אֲרָזִֽים
traditions.LXX: λέγων Ὅτι οὐκ ᾠκοδομήκατέ μοι οἶκον κέδρινον ;
traditions.VUL: et dixi : Quare non ædificástis mihi domum cédrinam ?
traditions.KJV: saying , Why have ye not built me an house of cedars ?

7.english_reference: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David ,

traditions.WLC: וְ֠ עַתָּה כֹּֽה תֹאמַ֞ר לְ עַבְדִּ֣ י לְ דָוִ֗יד
traditions.LXX: καὶ νῦν οὕτως ἐρεῖς τῷ δούλῳ μου Δαυεὶδ
traditions.VUL: Nunc ítaque sic loquéris ad servum meum David :
traditions.KJV: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David ,

7.english_reference: Thus saith the LORD of hosts ,

traditions.WLC: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת
traditions.LXX: Τάδε λέγει Κύριος Παντοκράτωρ
traditions.VUL: Hæc dicit Dóminus exercítuum :
traditions.KJV: Thus saith the LORD of hosts ,

7.english_reference: I took thee from the sheepcote ,

traditions.WLC: אֲנִ֤י לְקַחְתִּ֨י ךָ֙ מִן הַ נָּוֶ֔ה
traditions.LXX: Ἔλαβόν σε ἐκ τῆς μάνδρας
traditions.VUL: Ego tuli te , cum in páscuis
traditions.KJV: I took thee from the sheepcote , [ even ]

traditions.WLC: מִֽן אַחֲרֵ֖י הַ צֹּ֑אן
traditions.LXX: ἐξόπισθεν τῶν ποιμνίων
traditions.VUL: sequeréris gregem ,
traditions.KJV: from following the sheep ,

7.english_reference: that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel :

traditions.WLC: לִ הְי֣וֹת נָגִ֔יד עַ֖ל עַמִּ֥ י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.LXX: τοῦ εἶναι εἰς ἡγούμενον ἐπὶ τὸν λαόν μου Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: ut esses dux pópuli mei Israel .
traditions.KJV: that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel :

8.english_reference: And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked ,

traditions.WLC: וָֽ אֶהְיֶ֣ה עִמְּ ךָ֗ בְּ כֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָלַ֔כְתָּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἤμην μετὰ σοῦ ἐν πᾶσιν οἷς ἐπορεύθης ,
traditions.VUL: Et fui tecum quocúmque perrexísti ,
traditions.KJV: And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked ,

8.english_reference: and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee ,

traditions.WLC: וָ אַכְרִ֥ית אֶת כָּל אוֹיְבֶ֖י ךָ מִ פָּנֶ֑י ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξωλέθρευσα πάντας τοὺς ἐχθρούς σου ἀπὸ προσώπου σου ,
traditions.VUL: et interféci omnes inimícos tuos coram te ,
traditions.KJV: and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee ,

8.english_reference: and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that [ are ] in the earth .

traditions.WLC: וְ עָשִׂ֤יתִֽי לְ ךָ֙ שֵׁ֔ם כְּ שֵׁ֥ם הַ גְּדוֹלִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּ אָֽרֶץ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησά σοι ὄνομα κατὰ τὸ ὄνομα τῶν μεγάλων τῶν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς .
traditions.VUL: fecíque tibi nomen quasi uníus magnórum , qui celebrántur in terra .
traditions.KJV: and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that [ are ] in the earth .

9.english_reference: Also I will ordain a place for my people Israel ,

traditions.WLC: וְ שַׂמְתִּ֣י מָ֠קוֹם לְ עַמִּ֨ י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ θήσομαι τόπον τῷ λαῷ μου Ἰσραὴλ
traditions.VUL: Et dedi locum pópulo meo Israel :
traditions.KJV: Also I will ordain a place for my people Israel ,

traditions.WLC: וּ נְטַעְתִּ֨י הוּ֙
traditions.LXX: καὶ καταφυτεύσω αὐτόν ,
traditions.VUL: plantábitur ,
traditions.KJV: and will plant them ,

9.english_reference: and they shall dwell in their place ,

traditions.WLC: וְ שָׁכַ֣ן תַּחְתָּ֔י
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατασκηνώσει καθ᾽ ἑαυτὸν
traditions.VUL: et habitábit in eo ,
traditions.KJV: and they shall dwell in their place ,

9.english_reference: and shall be moved no more ;

traditions.WLC: ו וְ לֹ֥א יִרְגַּ֖ז ע֑וֹד
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐ μεριμνήσει ἔτι ,
traditions.VUL: et ultra non commovébitur :
traditions.KJV: and shall be moved no more ;

9.english_reference: neither shall the children of wickedness waste them any more ,

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹא יוֹסִ֤יפוּ בְנֵי עַוְלָה֙ לְ בַלֹּת֔ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐ προσθήσει ἀδικία τοῦ ταπεινῶσαι αὐτὸν
traditions.VUL: nec fílii iniquitátis átterent eos ,
traditions.KJV: neither shall the children of wickedness waste them any more ,

traditions.WLC: כַּ אֲשֶׁ֖ר בָּ רִאשׁוֹנָֽה
traditions.LXX: καθὼς ἀρχῆς .
traditions.VUL: sicut a princípio ,
traditions.KJV: as at the beginning ,

10.english_reference: And since the time that I commanded judges [ to be ] over my people Israel .

traditions.WLC: וּ לְ מִ יָּמִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוִּ֤יתִי שֹֽׁפְטִים֙ עַל עַמִּ֣ י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀφ᾽ ἡμερῶν ὧν ἔταξα κριτὰς ἐπὶ τὸν λαόν μου Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: ex diébus , quibus dedi iúdices pópulo meo Israel ,
traditions.KJV: And since the time that I commanded judges [ to be ] over my people Israel .

10.english_reference: Moreover I will subdue all thine enemies .

traditions.WLC: וְ הִכְנַ֖עְתִּי אֶת כָּל אוֹיְבֶ֑י ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐταπείνωσα ἅπαντας τοὺς ἐχθρούς σου ,
traditions.VUL: et humiliávi univérsos inimícos tuos .
traditions.KJV: Moreover I will subdue all thine enemies .

10.english_reference: Furthermore I tell thee that the LORD will build thee an house .

traditions.WLC: וָ אַגִּ֣ד לָ֔ ךְ וּ בַ֖יִת יִֽבְנֶה לְּ ךָ֥ יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ αὐξήσω σε · καὶ οἰκοδομήσει σε Κύριος .
traditions.VUL: Annúntio ergo tibi , quod ædificatúrus sit tibi Dóminus domum .
traditions.KJV: Furthermore I tell thee that the LORD will build thee an house .

11.english_reference: And it shall come to pass

traditions.WLC: וְ הָיָ֗ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσται
traditions.KJV: And it shall come to pass ,

11.english_reference: when thy days be expired that thou must go [ to be ] with thy fathers

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי מָלְא֤וּ יָמֶ֨י ךָ֙ לָ לֶ֣כֶת עִם אֲבֹתֶ֔י ךָ
traditions.LXX: ὅταν πληρωθῶσιν ἡμέραι σου καὶ κοιμηθήσῃ μετὰ τῶν πατέρων σου ,
traditions.VUL: Cumque impléveris dies tuos ut vadas ad patres tuos ,
traditions.KJV: when thy days be expired that thou must go [ to be ] with thy fathers ,

11.english_reference: that I will raise up thy seed after thee

traditions.WLC: וַ הֲקִֽימוֹתִ֤י אֶֽת זַרְעֲ ךָ֙ אַחֲרֶ֔י ךָ
traditions.LXX: ἀναστήσω τὸ σπέρμα σου μετὰ σέ ,
traditions.VUL: suscitábo semen tuum post te ,
traditions.KJV: that I will raise up thy seed after thee ,

11.english_reference: which shall be of thy sons

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִהְיֶ֖ה מִ בָּנֶ֑י ךָ
traditions.LXX: ὃ ἔσται ἐκ τῆς κοιλίας σου ,
traditions.VUL: quod erit de fíliis tuis :
traditions.KJV: which shall be of thy sons ;

11.english_reference: and I will establish his kingdom

traditions.WLC: וַ הֲכִינוֹתִ֖י אֶת מַלְכוּתֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἑτοιμάσω τὴν βασιλείαν αὐτοῦ ·
traditions.VUL: et stabíliam regnum eius .
traditions.KJV: and I will establish his kingdom .

12.english_reference: He shall build me an house

traditions.WLC: ה֥וּא יִבְנֶה לִּ֖ י בָּ֑יִת
traditions.LXX: αὐτὸς οἰκοδομήσει μοι οἶκον ,
traditions.VUL: Ipse ædificábit mihi domum ,
traditions.KJV: He shall build me an house ,

12.english_reference: and I will stablish his throne for ever

traditions.WLC: וְ כֹנַנְתִּ֥י אֶת כִּסְא֖ וֹ עַד עוֹלָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνορθώσω τὸν θρόνον αὐτοῦ ἕως αἰῶνος .
traditions.VUL: et firmábo sólium eius usque in ætérnum .
traditions.KJV: and I will stablish his throne for ever .

traditions.WLC: אֲנִי֙ אֶֽהְיֶה לּ֣ וֹ לְ אָ֔ב
traditions.LXX: ἐγὼ ἔσομαι αὐτῷ εἰς πατέρα
traditions.VUL: Ego ero ei in patrem ,
traditions.KJV: I will be his father ,

13.english_reference: and he shall be my son

traditions.WLC: וְ ה֖וּא יִֽהְיֶה לִּ֣ י לְ בֵ֑ן
traditions.LXX: καὶ αὐτὸς ἔσται μοι εἰς υἱόν ,
traditions.VUL: et ipse erit mihi in fílium :
traditions.KJV: and he shall be my son :

13.english_reference: and I will not take my mercy away from him

traditions.WLC: וְ חַסְדִּ י֙ לֹא אָסִ֣יר מֵֽ עִמּ֔ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὸ ἔλεός μου οὐκ ἀποστήσω ἀπ᾽ αὐτοῦ
traditions.VUL: et misericórdiam meam non áuferam ab eo ,
traditions.KJV: and I will not take my mercy away from him ,

13.english_reference: as I took [ it ] from [ him ] that was before thee

traditions.WLC: כַּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֲסִיר֔וֹתִי מֵ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה לְ פָנֶֽי ךָ
traditions.LXX: ὡς ἀπέστησα ἀπὸ τῶν ὄντων ἔμπροσθέν σου .
traditions.VUL: sicut ábstuli ab eo , qui ante te fuit .
traditions.KJV: as I took [ it ] from [ him ] that was before thee :

14.english_reference: But I will settle him in mine house and in my kingdom for ever

traditions.WLC: וְ הַֽעֲמַדְתִּ֛י הוּ בְּ בֵיתִ֥ י וּ בְ מַלְכוּתִ֖ י עַד הָ עוֹלָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ πιστώσω αὐτὸν ἐν οἴκῳ μου καὶ ἐν βασιλείᾳ αὐτοῦ ἕως αἰῶνος ,
traditions.VUL: Et státuam eum in domo mea , et in regno meo usque in sempitérnum :
traditions.KJV: But I will settle him in mine house and in my kingdom for ever :

14.english_reference: and his throne shall be established for evermore

traditions.WLC: וְ כִסְא֕ וֹ יִהְיֶ֥ה נָכ֖וֹן עַד עוֹלָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ θρόνος αὐτοῦ ἔσται ἀνωρθωμένος ἕως αἰῶνος .
traditions.VUL: et thronus eius erit firmíssimus in perpétuum .
traditions.KJV: and his throne shall be established for evermore .

15.english_reference: According to all these words , and according to all this vision

traditions.WLC: כְּ כֹל֙ הַ דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ אֵ֔לֶּה וּ כְ כֹ֖ל הֶ חָז֣וֹן הַ זֶּ֑ה
traditions.LXX: κατὰ πάντας τοὺς λόγους τούτους καὶ κατὰ πᾶσαν τὴν ὅρασιν ταύτην ,
traditions.VUL: Iuxta ómnia verba hæc , et iuxta univérsam visiónem istam ,
traditions.KJV: According to all these words , and according to all this vision ,

15.english_reference: so did Nathan speak unto David

traditions.WLC: כֵּ֛ן דִּבֶּ֥ר נָתָ֖ן אֶל דָּוִֽיד
traditions.LXX: οὕτως ἐλάλησεν Ναθὰν πρὸς Δαυείδ .
traditions.VUL: sic locútus est Nathan ad David .
traditions.KJV: so did Nathan speak unto David .

16.english_reference: And David the king came and sat before the LORD

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבֹא֙ הַ מֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֔יד וַ יֵּ֖שֶׁב לִ פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἦλθεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Δαυεὶδ καὶ ἐκάθισεν ἀπέναντι Κυρίου ,
traditions.VUL: Cumque venísset rex David , et sedísset coram Dómino ,
traditions.KJV: And David the king came and sat before the LORD ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֗אמֶר
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν
traditions.VUL: dixit :
traditions.KJV: and said ,

16.english_reference: Who [ am ] I , O LORD God

traditions.WLC: מִֽי אֲנִ֞י יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙
traditions.LXX: Τίς εἰμι ἐγώ , Κύριε ὁ θεός ,
traditions.VUL: Quis ego sum Dómine Deus ,
traditions.KJV: Who [ am ] I , O LORD God ,

traditions.WLC: וּ מִ֣י בֵיתִ֔ י
traditions.LXX: καὶ τίς ὁ οἶκός μου ,
traditions.VUL: et quæ domus mea ,
traditions.KJV: and what [ is ] mine house ,

16.english_reference: that thou hast brought me hitherto ?

traditions.WLC: כִּ֥י הֲבִיאֹתַ֖ נִי עַד הֲלֹֽם
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἠγάπησάς με ἕως αἰῶνος ;
traditions.VUL: ut præstáres mihi tália ?
traditions.KJV: that thou hast brought me hitherto ?

17.english_reference: And [ yet ] this was a small thing in thine eyes , O God

traditions.WLC: וַ תִּקְטַ֨ן זֹ֤את בְּ עֵינֶ֨י ךָ֙ אֱלֹהִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐσμικρύνθη ταῦτα ἐνώπιόν σου ὁ θεός ,
traditions.VUL: Sed et hoc parum visum est in conspéctu tuo ,
traditions.KJV: And [ yet ] this was a small thing in thine eyes , O God ;

17.english_reference: for thou hast [ also ] spoken of thy servant ’s house for a great while to come

traditions.WLC: וַ תְּדַבֵּ֥ר עַל בֵּֽית עַבְדְּ ךָ֖ לְ מֵ רָח֑וֹק
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐλάλησας ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον τοῦ παιδός σου ἐκ μακρῶν ,
traditions.VUL: ideóque locútus es super domum servi tui étiam in futúrum :
traditions.KJV: for thou hast [ also ] spoken of thy servant ’s house for a great while to come ,

17.english_reference: and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree , O LORD God

traditions.WLC: וּ רְאִיתַ֗ נִי כְּ ת֧וֹר הָ אָדָ֛ם הַֽ מַּעֲלָ֖ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπεῖδές με ὡς ὅρασις ἀνθρώπου καὶ ὕψωσάς με , Κύριε ὁ θεός .
traditions.VUL: et fecísti me spectábilem super omnes hómines Dómine Deus .
traditions.KJV: and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree , O LORD God .

18.english_reference: What can David [ speak ] more to thee for the honour of thy servant ?

traditions.WLC: מַה יּוֹסִ֨יף ע֥וֹד דָּוִ֛יד אֵלֶ֖י ךָ לְ כָב֣וֹד אֶת עַבְדֶּ֑ ךָ
traditions.LXX: τί προσθήσει ἔτι Δαυεὶδ πρὸς σὲ τοῦ δοξάσαι ;
traditions.VUL: Quid ultra áddere potest David , cum ita glorificáveris servum tuum ,
traditions.KJV: What can David [ speak ] more to thee for the honour of thy servant ?

traditions.WLC: וְ אַתָּ֖ה אֶֽת עַבְדְּ ךָ֥ יָדָֽעְתָּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ σὺ τὸν δοῦλόν σου οἶδας ,
traditions.VUL: et cognóveris eum ?
traditions.KJV: for thou knowest thy servant .

19.english_reference: O LORD , for thy servant ’s sake , and according to thine own heart , hast thou done all this greatness

traditions.WLC: יְהוָ֕ה בַּ עֲב֤וּר עַבְדְּ ךָ֙ וּֽ כְ לִבְּ ךָ֔ עָשִׂ֕יתָ אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ גְּדוּלָּ֖ה הַ זֹּ֑את
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατὰ τὴν καρδίαν σου ἐποίησας τὴν πᾶσαν μεγαλωσύνην .
traditions.VUL: Dómine propter fámulum tuum iuxta cor tuum fecísti omnem magnificéntiam hanc ,
traditions.KJV: O LORD , for thy servant ’s sake , and according to thine own heart , hast thou done all this greatness ,

19.english_reference: in making known all [ these ] great things

traditions.WLC: לְ הֹדִ֖יעַ אֶת כָּל הַ גְּדֻלּֽוֹת
traditions.VUL: et nota esse voluísti univérsa magnália .
traditions.KJV: in making known all [ these ] great things .

20.english_reference: O LORD , [ there is ] none like thee , neither [ is there any ] God beside thee

traditions.WLC: יְהוָה֙ אֵ֣ין כָּמ֔וֹ ךָ וְ אֵ֥ין אֱלֹהִ֖ים זוּלָתֶ֑ ךָ
traditions.LXX: Κύριε , οὐκ ἔστιν ὅμοιός σοι , οὐκ ἔστιν πλὴν σοῦ
traditions.VUL: Dómine non est símilis tui , et non est álius Deus absque te ,
traditions.KJV: O LORD , [ there is ] none like thee , neither [ is there any ] God beside thee ,

20.english_reference: according to all that we have heard with our ears

traditions.WLC: בְּ כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַ֖עְנוּ בְּ אָזְנֵֽי נוּ
traditions.LXX: κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἠκούσαμεν ἐν ὠσὶν ἡμῶν .
traditions.VUL: ex ómnibus , quos audívimus áuribus nostris .
traditions.KJV: according to all that we have heard with our ears .

21.english_reference: And what one nation in the earth [ is ] like thy people Israel

traditions.WLC: וּ מִי֙ כְּ עַמְּ ךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל גּ֥וֹי אֶחָ֖ד בָּ אָ֑רֶץ
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ὡς ὁ λαός σου Ἰσραὴλ ἔθνος ἔτι ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ,
traditions.VUL: Quis enim est álius , ut pópulus tuus Israel , gens una in terra ,
traditions.KJV: And what one nation in the earth [ is ] like thy people Israel ,

21.english_reference: whom God went to redeem [ to be ] his own people

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁר֩ הָלַ֨ךְ הָ אֱלֹהִ֜ים לִ פְדּ֧וֹת ל֣ וֹ עָ֗ם
traditions.LXX: ὡς ὡδήγησεν αὐτὸν ὁ θεὸς τοῦ λυτρώσασθαι ἑαυτῷ λαόν ,
traditions.VUL: ad quam perréxit Deus , ut liberáret , et fáceret pópulum sibi ,
traditions.KJV: whom God went to redeem [ to be ] his own people ,

21.english_reference: to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness

traditions.WLC: לָ שׂ֤וּם לְ ךָ֙ שֵׁ֚ם גְּדֻלּ֣וֹת וְ נֹרָא֔וֹת
traditions.LXX: τοῦ θέσθαι αὐτῷ ὄνομα μέγα καὶ ἐπιφανές ,
traditions.VUL: et magnitúdine sua atque terróribus
traditions.KJV: to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness ,

21.english_reference: by driving out nations from before thy people

traditions.WLC: לְ גָרֵ֗שׁ מִ פְּנֵ֧י עַמְּ ךָ֛
traditions.LXX: τοῦ ἐκβαλεῖν ἀπὸ προσώπου λαοῦ σου
traditions.VUL: eíceret natiónes a fácie eius ,
traditions.KJV: by driving out nations from before thy people ,

21.english_reference: whom thou hast redeemed out of Egypt ?

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁר פָּדִ֥יתָ מִ מִּצְרַ֖יִם גּוֹיִֽם
traditions.LXX: οὓς ἐλυτρώσω ἐξ Αἰγύπτου ἔθνη .
traditions.VUL: quem de Ægýpto liberárat ?
traditions.KJV: whom thou hast redeemed out of Egypt ?

22.english_reference: For thy people Israel didst thou make thine own people for ever

traditions.WLC: וַ֠ תִּתֵּן אֶת עַמְּ ךָ֨ יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל לְ ךָ֛ לְ עָ֖ם עַד עוֹלָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔδωκας τὸν λαόν σου Ἰσραὴλ σεαυτῷ λαὸν ἕως αἰῶνος ,
traditions.VUL: Et posuísti pópulum tuum Israel tibi in pópulum usque in ætérnum ,
traditions.KJV: For thy people Israel didst thou make thine own people for ever ;

22.english_reference: and thou , LORD , becamest their God .

traditions.WLC: וְ אַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה הָיִ֥יתָ לָ הֶ֖ם לֵ אלֹהִֽים
traditions.LXX: σὺ Κύριος αὐτοῖς εἰς θεόν .
traditions.VUL: et tu Dómine factus es Deus eius .
traditions.KJV: and thou , LORD , becamest their God .

23.english_reference: Therefore now , LORD , let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever

traditions.WLC: וְ עַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה הַ דָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבַּ֤רְתָּ עַֽל עַבְדְּ ךָ֙ וְ עַל בֵּית֔ וֹ יֵאָמֵ֖ן עַד עוֹלָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ νῦν , Κύριε , ὁ λόγος σου ὃν ἐλάλησας πρὸς τὸν παῖδά σου καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ πιστωθήτω ἕως αἰῶνος ,
traditions.VUL: Nunc ígitur Dómine , sermo , quem locútus es fámulo tuo , et super domum eius confirmétur in perpétuum ,
traditions.KJV: Therefore now , LORD , let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever ,

23.english_reference: and do as thou hast said .

traditions.VUL: et fac sicut locútus es .
traditions.KJV: and do as thou hast said .

24.english_reference: Let it even be established , that thy name may be magnified for ever

traditions.WLC: וְ֠ יֵֽאָמֵן וְ יִגְדַּ֨ל שִׁמְ ךָ֤ עַד עוֹלָם֙
traditions.VUL: Permaneátque et magnificétur nomen tuum usque in sempitérnum ,
traditions.KJV: Let it even be established , that thy name may be magnified for ever ,

24.english_reference: saying , The LORD of hosts [ is ] the God of Israel , [ even ] a God to Israel

traditions.WLC: לֵ אמֹ֔ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֱלֹהִ֖ים לְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: λεγόντων Κύριε Κύριε Παντοκράτωρ θεὸς Ἰσραήλ ·
traditions.VUL: et dicátur : Dóminus exercítuum Deus Israel ,
traditions.KJV: saying , The LORD of hosts [ is ] the God of Israel , [ even ] a God to Israel :

24.english_reference: and [ let ] the house of David thy servant [ be ] established before thee .

traditions.WLC: וּ בֵית דָּוִ֥יד עַבְדְּ ךָ֖ נָכ֥וֹן לְ פָנֶֽי ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἶκος Δαυεὶδ παιδός σου ἀνωρθωμένος ἐναντίον σου .
traditions.VUL: et domus David servi eius pérmanens coram eo .
traditions.KJV: and [ let ] the house of David thy servant [ be ] established before thee .

25.english_reference: For thou , O my God , hast told thy servant that thou wilt build him an house

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י אַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֗ י גָּלִ֨יתָ֙ אֶת אֹ֣זֶן עַבְדְּ ךָ֔ לִ בְנ֥וֹת ל֖ וֹ בָּ֑יִת
traditions.LXX: ὅτι σὺ ἤνοιξας τὸ οὖς τοῦ παιδός σου τοῦ οἰκοδομῆσαι αὐτῷ οἶκον ·
traditions.VUL: Tu enim Dómine Deus meus revelásti aurículam servi tui , ut ædificáres ei domum :
traditions.KJV: For thou , O my God , hast told thy servant that thou wilt build him an house :

25.english_reference: therefore thy servant hath found [ in his heart ] to pray before thee .

traditions.WLC: עַל כֵּן֙ מָצָ֣א עַבְדְּ ךָ֔ לְ הִתְפַּלֵּ֖ל לְ פָנֶֽי ךָ
traditions.LXX: διὰ τοῦτο εὗρεν ὁ παῖς σου τοῦ προσεύξασθαι κατὰ πρόσωπόν σου .
traditions.VUL: et idcírco invénit servus tuus fidúciam , ut oret coram te .
traditions.KJV: therefore thy servant hath found [ in his heart ] to pray before thee .

26.english_reference: And now , LORD , thou art God

traditions.WLC: וְ עַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה אַתָּה ה֖וּא הָ אֱלֹהִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ νῦν , Κύριε , σὺ εἶ αὐτὸς θεός ,
traditions.VUL: Nunc ergo Dómine , tu es Deus ,
traditions.KJV: And now , LORD , thou art God ,

26.english_reference: and hast promised this goodness unto thy servant :

traditions.WLC: וַ תְּדַבֵּר֙ עַֽל עַבְדְּ ךָ֔ הַ טּוֹבָ֖ה הַ זֹּֽאת
traditions.LXX: ἐλάλησας ἐπὶ τὸν δοῦλόν σου τὰ ἀγαθὰ ταῦτα .
traditions.VUL: et locútus es ad servum tuum tanta benefícia .
traditions.KJV: and hast promised this goodness unto thy servant :

27.english_reference: Now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant , that it may be before thee for ever

traditions.WLC: וְ עַתָּ֗ה הוֹאַ֨לְתָּ֙ לְ בָרֵךְ֙ אֶת בֵּ֣ית עַבְדְּ ךָ֔ לִ הְי֥וֹת לְ עוֹלָ֖ם לְ פָנֶ֑י ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ νῦν ἦρξαι εὐλογῆσαι τὸν οἶκον τοῦ παιδός σου τοῦ εἶναι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἐναντίον σου ·
traditions.VUL: Et cœpísti benedícere dómui servi tui , ut sit semper coram te :
traditions.KJV: Now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant , that it may be before thee for ever :

27.english_reference: for thou blessest , O LORD , and [ it shall be ] blessed for ever .

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ בֵּרַ֔כְתָּ וּ מְבֹרָ֖ךְ לְ עוֹלָֽם
traditions.LXX: ὅτι σὺ εὐλόγησας , καὶ εὐλόγησον εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα .
traditions.VUL: te enim Dómine benedicénte , benedícta erit in perpétuum .
traditions.KJV: for thou blessest , O LORD , and [ it shall be ] blessed for ever .
